name: obsidian-zettelcastings
description: publish your atomic notes to social platforms with the ZettelCastings service.

scripts.rlnotes: git log $(git describe --tags --abbrev=0)..HEAD --oneline > release-notes.md && git add release-notes.md
scripts.bump: node version-bump.mjs && git add manifest.json versions.json && yarn rlnotes
scripts.release: git commit -m $npm_package_version && git tag $npm_package_version && git push && git push --tags

author: Dayne Daniell
